_doc: Site charters for topic planning (DECISIONS D-B, STRATEGY 4.2 and 5). 'owns' = intents only this site may target; 'never' = intents it must not target. Reserved wikitours.ma concepts (config/wikitours-targets.json) and every other site's 'owns' list are always banned too. Read by scripts/plan-topics.js and shown in each generation brief.
audience: Moroccan pilgrims and their families (Morocco and Moroccans abroad), French readers at the root, Arabic under /ar/, English under /en/.

guideomra.ma.job: The Moroccan, step-by-step Omra and Hajj reference: rituals, documents, health rules, Nusuk and permits, official calendars, glossary. Every rule sourced.
owns: Omra rituals step by step (ihram, tawaf, sa'y, taqsir)
documents and visa rules for Moroccans
Nusuk and the Rawdah permit (rule only)
official Hajj calendar, eligibility and lottery (official facts only)
women, children and Omra (official texts only)
never: Hajj registration via an agency or agency quotas (wikitours.ma)
hard_rules: Qur'an verses, hadith and du'a are never written by the generator.
A rule is stated only with an approved fact; otherwise it goes in the unknowns section.

omra-ramadan.ma.job: Planning an Omra in Ramadan from Morocco: Ramadan dates (estimates until the moon sighting), the 1448H season deadlines, when to book, first days vs last 10 nights.
owns: when to book an Omra for Ramadan
first days vs last 10 nights of Ramadan
Omra while fasting (practical, no religious rulings)
hard_rules: Hijri dates are estimates « sous réserve d'observation du croissant » until announced.

agenceomra.ma.job: How to verify and choose a licensed Omra/Hajj agency in Morocco. No rankings.
owns: agency labelling and official lists (sourced rules only)
agency vs direct booking on Nusuk (neutral)
never: naming an agency without an official sanction source and legal_ok
reading an offer line by line (offresomra.ma)
hard_rules: Never claim booking without an agency is impossible.

prixomra.ma.job: Price observatory: official Hajj cost history, published averages with their source, what drives an Omra price, method.
owns: what makes an Omra price (hotel distance, room basis, flights, season)
never: Omra tiers économique to VIP guide (wikitours.ma)
hard_rules: Every price comes from an approved fact with its source and date; no fact, no number.

voyageomra.ma.job: The practical trip: flights from Morocco (national overview), luggage, heat and health on the road, travelling with elderly parents or children, getting around Makkah and Madinah.
owns: flights from Morocco to Jeddah/Madinah (national overview)
heat and health on the road (the network's only page)
hard_rules: Flight frequencies only from approved facts; otherwise « vérifiez auprès de la compagnie ».

omracasablanca.ma.job: « Partir de Casablanca »: CMN (Mohammed V) departure guide and Casablanca-Settat practical logistics for pilgrims.
owns: departing for Omra from Casablanca Mohammed V (CMN)
never: « agence omra casablanca » or any local agency intent (wikitours.ma + its Google Business Profile)
an office page or opening hours
hard_rules: Every page needs a verified Casablanca-specific fact.
No LocalBusiness markup, no office claims.

omrarabat.ma.job: « Partir de Rabat-Salé-Kénitra »: RBA departures (flynas Rabat-Jeddah) and regional logistics.
never: implying a Wiki Tours office in Rabat (Wiki Tours is based in Casablanca)
hard_rules: State honestly that Wiki Tours is based in Casablanca when the publisher is mentioned.

offresomra.ma.job: « Lire et comparer une offre Omra »: offer anatomy, red flags in an offer, what is included or not, offer calendar.
owns: what an offer includes or excludes
comparing two offers line by line (method, no named agencies)
never: a multi-agency offers board before legal_ok
Bab Makka or Wiki Tours offers presented as anything but « Offre de l'éditeur » from dated records
